tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | Techno-Functional Consultant
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in designing data pipelines, API migrations, and production support, combined with techno-functional consulting, requirements analysis and AI-assisted development. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with strong agile and DevOps experience team.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Expert Growth Manager
cover_en.hook: I am excited about your ambition to accelerate digital commerce growth and your data-driven approach. With 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have a proven track record of driving scalable e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) implementations at Rockwell Automation, designing product, catalog and pricing modules that align with enterprise growth objectives.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM, ERP and MDM systems via DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring seamless data flow for multi-channel commerce.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to capture requirements, write user stories and functional specs, translating them into scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Production & Support
bullets.text: Led production troubleshooting and CI/CD deployments on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), reducing incident resolution time and maintaining platform stability.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: I am excited by your ambition to accelerate digital commerce growth through data-driven strategies and integrated platforms. Your recent initiative to expand the B2B e-commerce ecosystem aligns perfectly with my experience delivering scalable SAP Commerce Cloud solutions and orchestrating PIM-ERP integrations that drive revenue and improve customer experience.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help you scale your commerce platform with proven SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and seamless integration capabilities.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell and Shell. I’d love to discuss how my API and integration experience can drive growth for your team.
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your SAP Commerce Cloud environment, implement OCC/Spartacus APIs and establish robust PIM-ERP data pipelines, while providing immediate production support to ensure uninterrupted commerce operations.
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with over five years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am drawn to your focus on accelerating commerce growth and your commitment to data-driven customer experiences. I can deliver rapid OCC API development, integrate PIM/ERP systems, and provide reliable production support, directly supporting your growth initiatives. I also note your emphasis on formal RFP processes and would apply my structured delivery approach. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
